components: short descending stroke and leftward lower curve
strokeOrder: begin at the upper tip and descend through the short stroke
without lifting, sweep left through the lower curve
lift once, then place the dot above

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, ز demonstration at 01:13–01:16 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated Persian ز body-first: begin at the upper tip, descend through the short stroke, and sweep left through the lower curve without lifting; after the complete re-series body, lift once and place the single dot above. This non-connector path fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and records Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the independently verified Arabic or Urdu ز source.

notes: Does not join to the following letter; the upper dot distinguishes it from ر.
